beats.text: In Burundi, 85.3% of workers work in agriculture. In the USA, it's 1.5%.
Burundi is the world's highest, where farming remains the primary livelihood for most people.
Burundi has 57 times the agricultural workforce share of the USA.
It counts working age people in agriculture, hunting, forestry and fishing.
Emerging economies show huge differences. India has 41.6%, China 21.7%, and Brazil 7.6%.
In the UK, just 0.9% of workers farm.
What percentage of workers work in agriculture in your country?
